**Financial hardship (2018)**

* Impoverishing Health spending: 8% of households
* Catastrophic health spending: 19% of households
* Most at risk: poorer households, older people, people in rural areas
* Main driver: outpatient medicines, especially for lower-income households

**Unmet need (2021)**

* Health care: 1% of people
* Dental care: 1.7% of people
